trello.name: Add queue depth alerts for entire worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add queue depth alerting across the whole worker fleet, not just payment workers, using uniform thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. Do it in one pass for all workers.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with backoff and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and on final failure send jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back rather than re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses, since existing coverage did not catch this.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools for workers and API
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In the same config file change: bump the DB connection pool from the default 20 to 100, and split the worker and API connection pools so they no longer share one pool. This addresses both the immediate capacity issue and the coupling between workers and the API.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook to replace old Kibana links (turned off in March) with current logging links. Document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage. Verify escalation phone numbers are current; at least one still routes to someone who left last year.

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout error rate alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Automate the status page so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically flips to 'investigating' with a template message, using the status provider's API. Wire it to the checkout alert first; other alerts can be extended later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a controlled chaos game day plan for testing the secondary payment processor failover, starting in staging then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The plan must be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until the review.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. This is a minor migration involving a config rename and changed persistence defaults, so it requires a proper change window scheduled with the infra calendar, not a casual Friday deploy.

trello.name: Write and send outage timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the postmortem timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow summarizing Tuesday's 41-minute degraded service outage.
